payload.title: Function tenant context, last PR: stop copying PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID and PAPYRUS_SINGLE_PUBLICATION_BACKEND into functions on shared stacks
payload.description: In amplify/site-backend.ts the tenant environment block (about lines 471-491) copies PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID into content-actions, category-action, assignment-action, newsroom-summary and editorial-checks and PAPYRUS_SINGLE_PUBLICATION_BACKEND into content-actions. After every handler is off PENDING, a shared stack gets neither; a dedicated stack keeps PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID (its fixed tenant). Run test-bootstrap-stage (slow, must stay under 2,000 resources).
